from.docs:
**string**: The type of the keys in the mapping. Can be one of `string` or `int`.

*See also: [Mapping Component](https://esphome.io/components/mapping#configuration-variables)*

id.docs:
**[ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: Give the mapping an ID so that you can refer to it later in [lambdas](https://esphome.io/automations/templates#config-lambda).

*See also: [Mapping Component](https://esphome.io/components/mapping#configuration-variables)*

to.docs:
**string**: The type of values in the map. May be one of `string` or `int` or a class specifier as discussed below.

*See also: [Mapping Component](https://esphome.io/components/mapping#configuration-variables)*
